case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

sup:DEMO-F1.subject: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
sup:DEMO-F1.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Thank you for your prompt response and the alternative proposals.

In the spirit of our long-standing partnership, we are willing to extend the contract to 24 months and accommodate the 60-day payment term. However, your proposed prices are not feasible given our cost structures; under these extended terms, we can offer €51.60 per unit. 

Our current proposal is a price of €51.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our shared history and look forward to continuing our cooperation on a sound foundation for both of our companies.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your revised proposals. In the interest of our long-standing partnership, we are willing to accept the 45-day payment term to offer a more favorable price. Your proposed prices, however, remain far below what is feasible for our foundry.

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Our main offer stands at a price of €51.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

Under the 45-day payment term, we can offer €51.20 per unit, representing a meaningful step towards an agreement. Specifically, this alternative option provides a price of €51.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.

Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your updated term sheets and the slight movement in your proposed prices. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

In the interest of our long-standing partnership, we are making a further concession to €51.20 per unit under the 60-day payment term. To be precise, our offer stands at a price of €51.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Your current proposals still do not reflect a sustainable level for our foundry, and we expect a more meaningful step from your side to conclude this agreement. Our traditional operations depend on fair conditions, and we look forward to reaching a balanced outcome together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your continued proposals and the small step forward. We deeply value the long relationship between our companies, and we take great pride in the quality of the work from our foundry. In response to your movement, we are prepared to lower our price to €51.00 per unit for the 60-day payment term.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

Our complete Angebot stands at a price of €51.00 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

We hope to continue our partnership and look forward to your decision.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your revised offer and the substantial movement in price. Over the years, our shared history and deep roots in our region have always meant a great deal to us here at the foundry. 

As we had already given our final offer for a start in December, we can only accept the delay to April 2027 if we agree on the 45-day payment term. Under these new terms, we are prepared to offer €50.80 per unit. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our primary Angebot is a price of €51.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: a price of €50.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
